what: L1 B6: the language the screens are drawn in (docs/design/LOOK_BIBLE.md rule 12), as data for the UI lead, who owns every element's look. Swatches (painted blocks: a flat field, one highlight band, the ink outline), the reading text and gold line, the semantic accents, the panel (a dark painted field in a bronze frame) and the line weight. Every color is measured by script from targets 08, 11 and 12 (look_l1/a2/targets.json; boxes in 'measure', full-size target pixels, Oklab medians) by tools/style/fx_measure.py ui-build; the targets are 1672 x 941, so px are scaled by 1080 / 941 to the game's 1080 lines. Read by logic/Look/FxLanguage.cs (UiLanguage); drawn by shaders/ui_cel_panel.gdshader.

bronze_body.what: the frame's bronze body between its highlight band and its shade (08's panel's left side, 11's top)

bronze_hi.what: the frame's one highlight band, on its outer side

field.what: the panel's dark painted field (its text and lines masked out by L and C)

statue_bronze.what: the Drowned Girl's lit bronze (stays bronze)

iron.what: an empty iron skill socket of 12's bar (its disk; the bronze rim masked out by L and C)

hostile.what: 12's red bar under her (the hostile/harm red)

bronze.from: the frame's body and highlight band (08's left side, 11's top: measure bronze_body, bronze_hi, ink); band = the highlight's 3 px of the 14 px frame

iron.from: 12's skill socket (measure iron): field its median, highlight its L90

parchment.from: DERIVED, not measured: no parchment block in 08, 11 or 12; the cream text (measure cream) lowered 0.12 L at 1.3x its C for the field, the cream itself the highlight

statue_bronze.from: 12's Drowned Girl (measure statue_bronze): she stays bronze

cream.from: bible rule 12's reading cream; 11's title measures beside it

gold.from: rule 12's one gold line; 11's divider measures beside it (its 1 px core is brighter than its AA)

panel.from: 08's lamp panel and 11's result panel: measure field (its median and its L10 for the deep edges), bronze_body, ink; frame 14 px of the targets (ink 2-3, highlight 2-3, body 8, inner ink 2-3), corner plates about 50 px

line.from: the frames' ink, 2-3 px in 08 and 11 (1672 x 941), at 1080 lines
